title: scabiosa atropurpurea subvar. amansii
intro: Scabiosa atropurpurea subvar. amansii, commonly known as Black Scabious, is a flowering plant native to the mountainous regions of the Mediterranean. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and promoting wound healing, attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes. The bioactive constituents in Scabiosa atropurpurea subvar. amansii contribute to its potential health benefits and therapeutic uses, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
